seed: Introduce the "Agent" layer (Claude Code native subagent definitions) at .agents/agents/ for the 5 PMCR-O lifecycle roles (orchestrator, planner, maker, checker, reflector), per Shawn's live request and the incremental Skill -> Agent -> Orchestration growth model he discussed in a separate session (Skills define mechanics, an AGENT.md describes when/how this repo delegates to a role that composes those skills - it does not replace the skill). Currently .agents/agents/ only has one generic example (code-reviewer.md, unrelated boilerplate). Each new AGENT.md must: (1) compose the existing .agents/skills/pmcro-<role> skill and plugins/pmcro/agents/<role>.md governance contract rather than duplicating their mechanics, (2) carry a Claude Code subagent frontmatter (name, description, tools) with a tools allowlist derived from that role's already-documented permissions (may/mayNot) in plugins/pmcro/agents/<role>.md, and (3) per Shawn's new standing instruction that all generated artifacts in this repo be economically justified going forward, include a real, evidence-grounded "Economic Rationale" section - not an invented ROI figure - explaining what cost this role's existence actually avoids, citing real repo history/evidence where available (e.g. this session's own live multi-agent collision, or the repo's L-CHECKER-GATE rationale) rather than a fabricated number.
